library_preparation_preflight.summary: httpspi-servlet depends only on already-supported com.sun.xml.ws:rt and jakarta.servlet-api (transitively resolved); it's structurally identical to the already-merged com.sun.xml.ws:servlet module, which needed no Docker image, extra dependency, or env/system-property setup — tests just hand-roll in-memory Servlet API fakes.
library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Mirror the com.sun.xml.ws:servlet test approach: implement lightweight in-memory fakes of ServletContext/HttpServletRequest/ServletConfig as needed (see tests/src/com.sun.xml.ws/servlet/4.0.5/src/test/java/com_sun_xml_ws/servlet/ServletTest.java) to exercise WSSPIServlet, WSSPIContextListener, DeploymentDescriptorParser, EndpointAdapterFactory, and Headers directly — no real servlet container or network I/O is required.
